We are currently seeking full-time warehouse employees for our new, state-of-the-art distribution center in Oss. This is a long-term position with excellent opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and multicultural environment. Important! This is a physically active role. Lifting crates and materials up to 25 kg is part of the job. Flexibility and a good work ethic are essential! What’s your job about? Inbound: Receive incoming goods from truck drivers. This is not a physically demanding role. CPS (Continuous Packing System): Perform voice picking and operate an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT). While previous experience is preferred, no certifications are required. This role may involve physically demanding tasks depending on the products handled. DPS (Direct Picking System): Similar to pick-to-light systems, products will be delivered to your station. The role requires working efficiently under time pressure but is not physically demanding. The department is located at a higher level in the distribution center, so comfort with heights is essential. Outbound: Organize trolleys and dollies for pick-up. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure products are delivered to the correct locations. This role can be physically demanding, particularly when handling heavier items such as alcohol and cigarettes. Emballage: Manage and recycle empty packaging materials such as bottles, crates, and cans. You will also check trolleys for reuse. This role may involve physically demanding tasks based on the materials handled. You must be flexible, ready to work on each department. What skills do you have? Good command of the English language. Previous experience in logistics and the ability to handle heavier loads (up to 20 kg). Flexibility to work in shifts and willingness to work overtime or weekends when necessary.
